A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same wrapped-Gaussian model and classifiers. Their main text, equations, four figures, two tables, and Appendices A–K are readable and support a reliable comparison.

before.justification: v1 reports original synthetic parameter-estimation experiments, a full-versus-diagonal covariance comparison, and classification results on eight real datasets (Figures 3–4 and Table 2).

after.justification: v3 retains the original synthetic experiments and real-data classification results, including the supplementary covariance comparison in Appendix J.

M1.justification: The wrapped-Gaussian construction, maximum-likelihood estimation, and Ho-WDA/He-WDA procedures remain unchanged. The new Algorithm 1 explicitly displays the sampling procedure already specified by Definition 4.1 in v1.

E1.justification: Both versions use the same synthetic settings and eight real datasets. Table 1 changes BreizhCrops from 'Hyperspectral imaging' to 'Multispectral imaging', but Appendix K describes the same satellite time-series data and classification task.

E2.justification: Table 2 retains the same MDM, TS-LDA, and TS-QDA comparators against Ho-WDA and He-WDA. Appendix K retains their implementations; the corrected logarithm-map description in Section 6.1 does not establish a change to the evaluated baselines.

E3.justification: Sample ranges, matrix dimensions, metrics, preprocessing, cross-subject testing, five-fold cross-validation, and optimization limits remain unchanged. Section 5.2's explicit full-covariance statement clarifies the setup already documented in v1's Appendix I.

E4.justification: The dimension/sample-size analysis and Appendix J's full-versus-diagonal covariance experiment are retained unchanged. The additional explanation of He-WDA's poorer performance introduces no new ablation or diagnostic experiment.

E5.justification: Appendices I and J retain five repetitions with different generated parameters. Table 2's plus/minus reporting and Figures 3–4's uncertainty bands are unchanged; no new seed information or statistical procedures appear.

E6.justification: All Table 2 accuracies and associated plus/minus values match, including Ho-WDA's 54.66 ± 0.45 on BreizhCrops. Figures 3–4 retain identical plotted results, with no added or removed experimental result entries.

T1.justification: Remark 4.12 adds an explicit alignment argument and example concerning whether an equivalence class contains a centered Gaussian. Appendix G corrects the norm identity in Proposition G.3's proof to ||ν||_2² = d. The principal theorems and remaining derivations are retained.

C1.justification: The main contributions remain the non-isotropic wrapped Gaussian, its theoretical properties and parameter estimation, the probabilistic classifier framework, and Ho-WDA/He-WDA. The added practical caveats do not redefine these central claims.

C2.justification: Section 6.4 adds a sample-size and covariance-estimation explanation for He-WDA underperforming Ho-WDA, using Salinas as an example. The conclusion newly acknowledges exponential/logarithmic-map computational bottlenecks and practical constraints on extending Gaussian-based methods.

D1.justification: Section 5.1 replaces v1's promised future code release with a specific GitHub repository and a statement that code is available. Appendix I still retains the release-on-acceptance wording. The documented libraries, preprocessing, and optimization limits are otherwise unchanged.

R1.justification: Remark 3.1 adds alternative-metric context citing Arsigny et al. (2005), Sra (2015), Chevallier et al. (2021), and Thanwerdas (2022). Kingma and Welling (2013) is removed. The Dudoit et al. (2002) entry is corrected rather than newly introduced, and the central positioning remains stable.

P1.justification: v3 makes localized prose and terminology corrections, expands several explanations, and adds an impact statement and acknowledgments. Section 6.1 corrects 'exponential map' to 'logarithm map'. The main section sequence and Appendices A–K remain intact.

P2.justification: v3 adds a boxed sampling algorithm, relocates Table 1, enlarges appendix proof text, and reflows equations and page layouts. The four existing figures and two tables retain their essential designs and content.

improvement.justification: v3 improves clarity and correctness through the logarithm-map correction, the Appendix G norm correction, more readable proofs, and useful computational and sample-size qualifications. The concrete code link improves access information, although Appendix I retains inconsistent release wording. These are supported, limited gains in exposition and documentation.
